goal: Read the exact existing public native Tourvisor meals gateway to resolve monitor meal IDs.
boundaries: One fixed HTTPS GET through the established public gateway, no tour search, auth headers, customer data, server connection or message edit.
criteria: HTTP200 JSON and exact native IDs with public names. No inference from canonical meal IDs.
risks: The gateway can be unavailable or require access. Stop on any redirect, denial or unrecognized response. This does not prove price total or availability.
